name: test_bridge
description: Close the edit→verify loop. action=run: execute tests, parse output, enrich failures with code context + root cause hints. action=suggest: recommend tests after code changes. action=discover: find available tests for a file. For finding test files without running, use find_tests. After fixing failures, re-run. Pairs with rename_symbol, mock_sync.

action.description: run: execute tests; suggest: recommend tests after changes; discover: find available tests

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory.

file.description: For action=suggest/discover: source file path relative to workspace_dir

symbol.description: For action=suggest: narrow to a specific symbol

framework.description: Override auto-detection: pytest, jest, vitest, go_test, cargo_test, maven, gradle
